title: Advanced Layout Techniques
description: Using advanced CSS methods to build complex and flexible layouts.

flashcards.question: What is the CSS Multi-column Layout?
flashcards.answer: A layout method that divides content into multiple columns, similar to newspaper style.

flashcards.question: Which properties are used in multi-column layout?
What is the difference between Flexbox and Grid layouts?
flashcards.answer: Flexbox is one-dimensional (row or column), Grid is two-dimensional (rows and columns).

flashcards.question: How does the CSS subgrid feature work?
flashcards.answer: It allows nested grids to inherit the parent grid’s track sizing.

flashcards.question: What is the purpose of the CSS float property?
flashcards.answer: To place elements to the left or right and allow text to wrap around them.

flashcards.question: Why is clearfix used in CSS layouts?
flashcards.answer: To clear floats and ensure the container wraps floated children.

flashcards.question: What are CSS regions?
flashcards.answer: A module that allows content to flow through multiple containers or regions.

flashcards.question: How do you center a block element horizontally using CSS?
flashcards.answer: By setting margin-left and margin-right to auto.

flashcards.question: What is the difference between position: relative and position: absolute?
flashcards.answer: Relative positions relative to its normal place; absolute positions relative to the nearest positioned ancestor.
